# Bevelled parts and slabs as Blender 5.2 made them for the families (2026-11-17), a line a field: rec <family/model/part>
# kind width segments angle ...; the mesh the modifier was given (bv points, bf faces, bs smooth, be sharp edges) and what it
# made of it (ov, of, on a normal a corner, oe sharp edges); a slab's outlines as the script gave them (loops). Floats as bits.
# The two parts named @joined (2026-11-18) were changed after their bevel was asked for (the stone pushed about by noise, the
# brace's object turned by a matrix): bv as the part was when it was joined, lrs its place, turn and scale then, jv its points
# once joined, jl the joined part's place.
